details: CONFIRMED. recheckUnit (cycle.js:279) builds the fallback text from it.branch. refusal() (cycle.js:75-77) refuses
recheck when RELAY, so the text is only ever sent in project mode. show_check (bin/relay:801) with a branch name calls
relay_marks.show (lib/relay_marks.py:277), whose output is three lines: gate, mark open/queued, outside; per-finding
verdicts are only in the check JSON. relay_verdict.record_check writes the JSON at `report` and commits no mark; in
project mode the cycle's check reports are <S>/reports/check-<tag>.json (finish, cycle.js:209). The new test
test_recheck_without_fixes_names_the_branchs_newest_check_record asserts the prompt text only, so it passes although
the text leads nowhere. Pass-case 2 of the queue item ("passes the branch's newest check record so verdicts already
MET are rechecked against their fixes") is not met in substance.
Size: 15 minutes.

failing_case: Project without .relay/ (relay=false; recheck is refused in relay mode). Unit {kind: recheck, name: x-after-main,
findings: <S>/reports/review-x.json, branch: wt/x}, no fixes; the earlier check <S>/reports/check-x.json has F1, F2 MET.
Prompt now: "Fixes: `the newest check record of wt/x (read with relay check show wt/x -C <wt>)`". Running that command
in such a repo prints:
gate: none yet
mark: no mark yet
outside: unknown (no mark yet)
No verdict and no fix report reach the checker, so F1, F2 come back NOT MET exactly as with Fixes: none (the item's
failing case). Even in a repo with marks, `relay check show <branch>` prints only "mark <sha>: open N, queued M", not
per-finding verdicts.
Should: the prompt names a source that holds the earlier verdicts and fix reports, e.g. the earlier check JSON
<S>/reports/check-x.json (readable with relay check show <file>).
fix_hint: Point the fallback at the scratch check records the script itself wrote: e.g. "the newest check record of this
worktree among ${S}/reports/check-*.json (its `worktree` field is ${it.wt}); read it with relay check show <file>; carry
each MET verdict whose files did not change since its head". Or take an optional `check` record path field. A test
asserting the prompt names ${S}/reports and `relay check show <file>`.
